title: Octostyle
summary: OC'TOSTYLE, noun [Gr. eight, and style.] In ancient architecture, the face of an edifice adorned with eight columns, or a range of eight columns.

inlines.v: OC'TOSTYLE, noun [Gr. eight, and style.] In ancient architecture, the face of an edifice adorned with eight columns, or a range of eight columns.
